findings.claim: The approved local page, its static assets, and authenticated state reads returned HTTP 200 with zero failed requests, page errors, or console entries in the captured journey.
unknowns: No other product origin or account surface was exercised.

unknowns: The absent Executive database prevented a current canonical runtime read.

findings.claim: Raw absolute-path diagnostics dominate the mobile first viewport and displace the calm decision outcome the Chairman needs.
unknowns: No causal user study or witnessed task timing was performed.

findings.claim: On desktop, source-status chips and the persistent Surfaces rail compete with an unavailable decision area instead of resolving whether the Chairman should act, wait, or delegate.
unknowns: No comparative usability benchmark was run.

wrong_target.detail: An isolated wrong loopback path returned HTTP 404; response SHA-256 442382ccc7e785caee0f26ebc4f061713d4cd1a2eeb1ae79b3994f9d8878964d.

stale_capture.detail: The UI exposed Agent OS at 22h, GitHub live cache at 17h, and composed state at 59m rather than silently presenting those inputs as current.

different_build.detail: The deployed Mastermind revision differed from the protected Mastermind revision at the capture epoch.

different_viewport_or_data_state.detail: Desktop and mobile captures have distinct viewport identities, PNG digests, and semantic artifact digests while retaining the same degraded source envelope.

missing_screenshot_bytes.detail: The Reality contract refuses a visual claim unless screenshot bytes are present and a structured consumption receipt binds the intended model to the exact PNG identity.

broken_browser_connection.detail: Opera reported Browser not connected; this is retained as provider-specific evidence and is not generalized to all browser providers.

excluded_account_surface.detail: No managed Chairman account or ChatGPT provider surface was opened, inspected, or actuated.

effect.detail: The bounded journey was read-only. No product, account, provider, source, or lifecycle mutation was attempted or observed.

cleanup.detail: The isolated browser process and temporary profile are absent; the persistent Control Room and unrelated browser, trace, observability, account, and worker resources were left unchanged.

limitations: This is a historical capture epoch, not a claim about current product or runtime state.
No accepted Executive runtime admission existed for the Reality package operation at capture time.
No causal user study, witnessed completion-time benchmark, or fabricated speed multiplier is claimed.
Private screenshots, state payloads, semantic snapshots, and traces remain on the authorized Mac and are not published in this public repository.
No managed Chairman account, Web-Sol ChatGPT surface, or provider-native account target was tested.
Visual consumption is supported by a session-local attestation bound to exact image digests; the provider exposed no independent native consumption timestamp or immutable conversation identifier.

next_action.action: Review and admit the package-local Reality fragment through the existing marketplace and validator owner, then qualify the exact installed generation and repeat one approved product journey.
